जार का गैस्केट घिसा है या कपलर ढीला है
जार में ठंडा पानी भरा था

task.title: Kitchen practical check: 7 real situations and an optional photo of your cooking
task.brief: This takes about 10 minutes. First answer 7 short questions. Each one describes a real kitchen situation (fridge storage, chopping, gas stove, store room) and asks which way is safe and hygienic. Then, if you want, upload one photo of your own past work: a dish you cooked, a clean and organised work station, or a well-arranged store shelf. You can also upload a cooking, food safety or ITI certificate instead. Do not show any faces in the photo. The photo is optional, but a clear, genuine one helps employers trust your skill.
key_points: Keeps raw and cooked food apart
Picks the safe way with knives, gas and hot oil
Uses FIFO and labels in storage
Photo shows real cooking or a clean work station

rubric.label: Relevance
rubric.guide: 0 = no photo or unrelated photo, 3 = kitchen work but unclear, 5 = clear photo of own dish, station or store

rubric.label: Genuineness
rubric.guide: 0 = looks copied from the internet, 3 = probably own work, 5 = clearly own work or a real certificate

rubric.label: Safety and hygiene
rubric.guide: 0 = unsafe or dirty practice visible, 3 = mostly fine, 5 = clean, safe, hygienic set-up and no faces shown

situations.q: Which picture shows raw and cooked food stored correctly in a fridge?
options: Raw chicken placed on top of the cooked curry
Cooked food covered on top, raw meat covered below
Everything open on one shelf

te.q: ఫ్రిజ్‌లో పచ్చి, వండిన ఆహారం సరిగ్గా పెట్టినది ఏది?
options: వండిన కర్రీ పైన పచ్చి చికెన్

అన్నీ మూత లేకుండా ఒకే అరలో
తలుపు ర్యాక్‌లో పచ్చి చేప

hi.q: फ़्रिज में कच्चा और पका खाना सही तरीक़े से कहाँ रखा है?

situations.q: Which way of holding vegetables while chopping is safe?
options: Fingers flat and stretched out
